topPRs.title: feat(orchestrator): coding-lane repo flow, honest lifecycle voice, and full opencode removal
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
The coding lane's repo dev-flow end to end, hardened against a small planner model and live-proven with casual human phrasing ("yo can u add a lil one-line description to the readme in my eliza-code-sandbox repo and put up a pr" → clone → child commits → push → PR on GitHub). Also completes the opencode removal — eliza-code is the native in-repo coding agent.

## What changed

**Repo flow**
- Repo-targeted spawns provision a workspace clone in BOTH the spawn_agent and create paths. Previously the repo param silently dropped on one path and the child ran in the host cwd fallback (live: it reported home-directory entries as "files it created").
- Repo resolution tolerates human phrasing: URLs, `owner/name` slugs, and possessive bare names ("my eliza-code-sandbox repo") resolved via the GitHub token owner.
- Auto-submit for provisioned workspaces: on task completion with PR intent, the orchestrator aligns the registered branch onto the child's exec-branch work, pushes, opens the requested PR, notifies the origin room in the agent's own phrased voice (mustInclude the PR URL), and re-arms the once-per-task stamp on failure.

**Spawn admission**
- Idle kept-alive sessions no longer count against the spawn gate (the 480s stall class).
- The near-duplicate guard excludes parked/terminal tasks, uses symmetric token similarity, and strips route boilerplate before comparing goals (live false-positives: "tide-glass" vs "ember-tide").
- Chained spawns inherit the user's origin room instead of stamping the task room; spawning without a resolvable durable task service degrades loudly.

**Lifecycle honesty**
- The watchdog grills a session once per lifetime and skips idle-by-design tasks (kills the 4-minute nag loop); auto-verify give-up parks the task visibly with a one-time origin notice; verify-churn completions stay off the user channel; sub-agent completions with internal-marker sources resolve the room's real connector before delivery.
- User-facing lane text is model-phrased via `phraseForUser` (no canned strings); Discord `sendMessageToTarget` projects interaction blocks instead of leaking raw markers.
- GC and auto-submit failure warns carry their context in the message string (the pretty transport drops structured payloads on warn lines — live diagnosis had to fall back to filesystem forensics).

**opencode removal**
- Vendor submodule, bin shims, adapter config, spawn auto-detect, model surfaces (UI + routes + cockpit modes), and docs; `ELIZA_CODE_*` is the provider env family (`applyElizaCodeProviderEnv`).

## Evidence

- Orchestrator suite green in a clean develop-based worktree (full `vitest run`, exit 0); plugin typecheck clean (the repo-wide baseline errors in unrelated packages reproduce identically on unmodified develop).
- Live receipts: sandbox PRs opened end-to-end by the agent on the reference deployment; spawn-gate stalls, nag loops, and canned-voice leaks absent from trajectories since the respective fixes.
- Contains the create-task alias-pin test update shared with #21636 (identical bytes; either merge order is clean).
